applicabilityBasis.summary: VNX Global Ltd issues VGBP for payment and settlement with a one-to-one GBP value reference and eligible-institution fiat redemption at par. GBP is national-currency monetary value under GENIUS definitions; a non-USD peg is not a payment-token exclusion. Redemption remains subject to customer eligibility and the operative delay and in-kind terms.

genius.licensingRegulator: Bermuda Monetary Authority; Class M digital asset business licence, registration 202605548
genius.notes: The current issuer is VNX Global Ltd in Bermuda, not VNX Commodities AG, the Liechtenstein generator of VNXAU. A live exact-name BMA directory search confirms Class M registration 202605548, effective April 13, 2026 and expiring April 12, 2027. That foreign digital asset business licence is not U.S. GENIUS permission or a registered foreign-issuer exception. The bounded U.S. regulator, Federal Register and issuer checks below located no VGBP-specific approval, official application, foreign registration or issuer-announced U.S. GENIUS path. Issuer pathway and foreign exception therefore remain unknown. Institutional documentation requires verified organizations and a GBP 100,000 minimum; fiat redemption is described as at par with about one business day for settlement, while operative terms preserve reserve-related delay and in-kind redemption. The public audits index links July, August and September 2026 Apex reports covering VGBP. The September report reconciles GBP 126,595.48 of covered VGBP to GBP 126,596.33 of cash in the designated VNX Global account at Bermuda Commercial Bank on its two testing dates. Public disclosure and assurance do not establish regulatory authorization. No issuer-specific enforcement conclusion is asserted.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of October 28, 2026, these bounded checks located no public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, registered foreign-issuer exception or issuer-announced U.S. GENIUS route for VNX Global Ltd or VGBP. The Bermuda licence establishes foreign home-regulator context only. Search absence is recorded as a dated negative finding, not proof that no unpublished application or relationship exists.
